user.title: Select connection type
user.description: Pick how the Modbus master is reached. A serial port always speaks RTU, a TCP gateway speaks Modbus TCP or RTU over TCP.

tcp.title: Configure TCP connection
tcp.description: The host and port of the Modbus gateway. The frame format must match the gateway, Modbus TCP is the default and RTU over TCP is for serial to ethernet gateways.

serial_pick.title: Select serial port
serial_pick.description: The ports are detected on the system running Home Assistant. Choose a device or enter the path manually.

serial_manual.title: Serial device path
serial_manual.description: The device path as Home Assistant sees it, for example /dev/ttyUSB0, /dev/ttyS0 or COM3. In Docker the host device has to be mapped into the container.

serial_params.title: Serial port settings
serial_params.description: These must match the device. The defaults are 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity and one stop bit.

slave.title: Modbus slave address
slave.description: The unit ID of the device on this connection, 10 is 0x0A. The coil count is the number of coils the device has, a 32 channel module uses 32.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid host name or IP address
error.invalid_serial_path: Enter a valid serial device path
error.slave_already_added: This slave address is already used on this connection
error.no_slaves: Add at least one slave address
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect, check the serial settings or the slave address

write_coil.name: Write coil
write_coil.description: Write a coil value to a Modbus device.

hub.name: Hub
hub.description: Entry title shown in Settings. Leave empty when only one connection is configured.

write_register.name: Write register
write_register.description: Write a register value. Not supported by this device profile.
